reader_summary.headline: Matt Brown is the Founder CEO of CAIS.
reader_summary.overview: Matt Brown is the Founder CEO of CAIS. Our conversation covers Matt's background as both a financial advisor and distributor of alternatives that collectively led to the idea behind CAIS. We discuss the development of a two-sided platform, structural features for both financial advisors and managers, and challenges along the way.

key_points.text: Matt Brown is the Founder CEO of CAIS.
We then turn to the wave of capital coming from this community and what it means for investors.
Lastly, we discuss Matt's perspective on leadership and the future of CAIS.
